notes: A capped stone well beside a garden path. It stands on its own tile: the sealed garden palette refuses a placement on an occupied tile, and it is a solid mass in src/footprints.js, so a resident walks around it.
The voxel scene draws it through the generic prop branch of src/voxel-world.js furniture(), which is what rules.geometry records; world.js draws the same silhouette on the pixel map.
A decoration only. It yields no water resource, carries no recipe and costs nothing to place.
